title: Test suite is a shallow smoke test, not correctness coverage
evidence: tests.sh:9-12 only grep for presence of 'brazilian-soccer','Flamengo','matches','players'; three of six tools (head_to_head, competition_standings, competition_statistics) are never invoked and no numeric result (W/L/D, standings order, goal aggregates) is asserted
suggestion: Add scenarios that call the remaining tools and assert expected head-to-head record, standings ordering, and goals-per-match values

title: Substring team matching can mismatch teams in stats and head-to-head
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp.c:42 team_eq() returns true when either normalized name is a substring of the other (strstr both directions), so a short/normalized team name that is a substring of another club can be aggregated into the wrong team's stats
suggestion: Use exact normalized equality (same_team) for team_statistics/head_to_head aggregation; keep substring matching only for user-facing search filters

title: FIFA header BOM strip assumes the BOM is always present
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp.c:53 unconditionally does h[0]+=3 to skip a UTF-8 BOM on the first header cell; if fifa_data.csv had no BOM the first column header would be corrupted by dropping 3 real bytes
suggestion: Strip the BOM conditionally by checking for the 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF prefix before advancing

title: Extended-dataset season is derived from the date string, undocumented
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp.c:52 load_extended sets season=atoi(date) (e.g. '2020-...' -> 2020) and round=0 for BR-Football-Dataset.csv, which has no season/round columns; this derivation is not documented
suggestion: Note in README that BR-Football-Dataset season is inferred from the match date year
